points.quote: The default position across the University is that you may use GenAI in reasonable and appropriate ways to support your work.
points.gist: By default, students may use GenAI in reasonable and appropriate ways to support their work.

points.quote: you always need to check your Assessment Guidance document before using GenAI. Using it outside the permitted scope may be considered misrepresentation under the University’s Academic Integrity Policy and Academic Misconduct Procedure.
points.gist: Check the Assessment Guidance document before using GenAI; use outside the permitted scope may count as misrepresentation.

points.quote: Use Microsoft 365 Copilot signed in with your University account wherever possible, as this is the University-approved GenAI tool and is covered by the University's data security policy.
points.gist: Use Microsoft 365 Copilot signed in with a University account where possible, as the approved tool covered by data security policy.

points.quote: Never enter personal data, unpublished research, your own or anyone else’s work, or other sensitive or confidential information into a tool that is not University-approved.
points.gist: Never enter personal data, unpublished research, anyone's work or sensitive information into a tool that is not University-approved.

points.quote: Verify its outputs using reliable original sources (such as professional websites, academic books and journal articles) and cite those sources as your evidence - not the GenAI tool.
points.gist: Verify GenAI outputs with reliable original sources and cite those sources, not the GenAI tool.

points.quote: You remain responsible for everything you submit.
points.gist: You remain responsible for everything you submit.

points.quote: All University of Salford students should complete our GenAI eLearning so that you understand how to use it responsibly and effectively in your studies.
points.gist: All students should complete the GenAI eLearning.

points.quote: If your chosen search engine automatically includes a GenAI summary, you can exclude this by adding '-AI' at the end of your search request.
points.gist: A GenAI search summary can be excluded by adding '-AI' to the end of the search request.

points.quote: Cooling the hardware used for AI operations consumes large amounts of water, which can strain local water supplies and impact ecosystems. We aren’t saying don’t use GenAI, but ensure your use is considered and thoughtful.
points.gist: AI hardware cooling uses large amounts of water; the university says use should be considered and thoughtful.

points.quote: Choose simpler tools (e.g. spell-check) when appropriate.
points.gist: Choose simpler tools such as spell-check when appropriate.
